content_units: Melbourne Dinner Shortlist for 4
Best overall fit:   Cedar Table  . It matches the budget well, handles the dietary needs cleanly, and is the strongest option for a quieter Saturday dinner around   19:30  .
Ranked Restaurant Comparison
Rank   Restaurant   Value   Dietary Fit   Convenience for Your Group   Overall Take
1   Cedar Table   9/10   10/10   9/10   Best balance of price, quiet atmosphere, and strong vegetarian suitability
2   Trattoria Lane   8/10   8/10   8/10   Safe, solid all-rounder with good mains pricing and manageable noise
3   Lotus Bowl   9/10   7/10   7/10   Great value and vegetarian choice, but shellfish on menu adds some caution
4   Ember Grill   4/10   3/10   4/10   Weak fit due to louder room, limited vegetarian options, and budget pressure
Why Each Place Lands Where It Does
1) Cedar Table
-   Budget:   Mains at   AUD 20-34  , comfortably under your   AUD 45 pp   target.
-   Dietary fit:   Strong vegetarian options and   not shellfish-heavy  , so it suits both dietary constraints well.
-   Noise:   Listed as   quiet  , which is the best match for your preference.
-   Best for:   A relaxed group dinner where everyone can order easily without compromise.
2) Trattoria Lane
-   Budget:   Mains at   AUD 24-38  , still within range.
-   Dietary fit:   Vegetarian options are available, and shellfish is not a major menu focus.
-   Noise:     Moderate  , so acceptable, though not as good as Cedar Table.
-   Best for:   A dependable backup if you want familiar, flexible Italian.
3) Lotus Bowl
-   Budget:   Mains at   AUD 18-29  , the strongest pure value option.
-   Dietary fit:   Strong vegetarian offering, but   some shellfish dishes   mean the shellfish-avoiding diner may need to order more carefully.
-   Noise:     Moderate  , acceptable but not especially calm.
-   Best for:   Budget-conscious groups willing to double-check menu choices.
4) Ember Grill
-   Budget:   Mains at   AUD 32-52  , which can push past your target once drinks/sides are added.
-   Dietary fit:   Limited vegetarian options makes it the weakest fit for your group.
-   Noise:     Loud  , which conflicts with your preference.
-   Best for:   Not this occasion unless the group strongly prioritizes steak over the other constraints.
Best Booking Choice for Saturday 19:30
Choose Cedar Table first.
It is the only option that scores strongly across all three priorities in order:   value, dietary fit, and convenience/noise  .
Runner-up:     Trattoria Lane   if Cedar Table is unavailable.
Quick Actions
Book Cedar Table
Backup at Trattoria Lane
